title: Email and SMS
hint: How this business sends messages to customers, suppliers and staff. Receipts, reminders and payslips go out through these channels.
smsOff: Not set up. SMS reminders and receipts are not sent until you set up a gateway.
emailOff: Not set up. Emails are not sent until you set up a gateway.
secretsHidden: Keys and passwords are stored encrypted and never shown again.
unknownProvider: This channel uses a gateway this screen does not know. Replace it to change it.
switchOffAsk: Stop sending {{channel}}? Messages will not go out until you set it up again.
saved: Channel saved. Send a test message to check it.
replaceWarning: Saving replaces the current settings. The old keys stop being used.
writeOnly: Stored encrypted. You cannot see it again after saving.
nameHint: A label for your own reference.
untestedNote: Always send a test message after saving to be sure the gateway accepts your keys.
testHint: A short test message is sent to this recipient.
testQueued: Test message queued for {{to}}. It is sent in a moment: check the list below.
failedGeneric: The message could not be sent.
